schools.text: Swift calls for fully funding K–12 schools, including staffing, facilities, technology, counseling, academics, and extracurricular programs.
schools.quote: Fully fund K-12 education: Ensure every school has adequate staffing, updated facilities, modern technology, mental health counselors, and strong academics — including STEM, arts, and extracurriculars.

safety.text: Swift supports resources for first responders alongside investments in prevention and community partnerships.
safety.quote: Paula will fight to keep our families and neighborhoods safe by ensuring first responders have the resources they need while investing in the prevention and community partnerships that stop problems before they start.

abortion.text: Swift lists protecting reproductive freedom among her policy priorities.
abortion.quote: Protecting reproductive freedom, voting rights, and civil rights

energy.text: Swift presents clean-energy investment as a way to reduce fossil-fuel dependence while lowering household energy costs.
energy.quote: Lower utility bills through clean energy: Invest in solar, wind, and grid upgrades that reduce our dependence on expensive fossil fuels and bring down energy costs for families.

tax.text: Ta says Californians are overtaxed and calls for a middle-class tax cut.
tax.quote: I think we need to hold Sacramento politicians accountable for their endless spending and pass a tax cut for the middle class.

schools.text: Ta says California should expand school choice so students are not limited by their ZIP code.
schools.quote: I also believe we should expand school choice so that a child’s academic achievement isn’t decided by the zip code they live in.

safety.text: Ta supports fully funding police departments to increase deterrence and public safety.
safety.quote: Second, I support fully funding police departments to boost safety and crime deterrence.

sentencing.text: Ta supports ending early-release and nonprosecution policies for people he describes as dangerous criminals.
sentencing.quote: First, I support ending policies that allow dangerous criminals to be let out of jail early or to not be prosecuted at all.

immigration.text: Ta supports law-enforcement efforts to enforce immigration laws and opposes sanctuary cities.
immigration.quote: Third, I will support law enforcement efforts to enforce our immigration laws and I will oppose Sanctuary Cities.

voting.text: Ta voted against SB 1174, which prohibited local governments from requiring identification to vote or submit a ballot.
voting.quote: Alanis, Chen, Megan Dahle, Davies, Dixon, Essayli, Gallagher, Hoover, Lackey, Mathis, Jim Patterson, Joe Patterson, Sanchez, Ta, Waldron, Wallis
